committees.name: Conference Committee
committees.currentFocus: Building the 2027 Denver conference committee ahead of the October 27 kickoff.
committees.notes: Jennifer Anderson is now co-chair alongside Mariel. With Michele's help, the committee has pulled together returning members and new volunteers, plus AVTE members in the Denver area to support local planning. The first meeting is on the calendar.
committees.nextSteps: Welcome new and returning members at the October 27 kickoff, assign duties, and open sponsorship conversations.

committees.name: JAVTE
committees.currentFocus: Producing the Winter edition, publishing January 18.
committees.notes: The committee welcomed new reviewer Sarah Machiniak, bringing the bench to 7 reviewers who can form 3 review teams at any time. The goal is 4 to 5 teams so reviews move faster. Oreta is working back through submissions since January 2025 to close out any open reviews. The journal has a healthy backlog of articles and cover shots ready to go.
committees.nextSteps: Winter edition submissions are due December 1, reviews are due December 21, and the edition publishes January 18. Send anyone interested in serving as an editor or writer to Oreta.

committees.name: Resource Exchange
committees.currentFocus: Keeping the Resource Exchange a top AVTE priority after Portland
committees.notes: No new activity since the last report. The committee settled on a new meeting day and time, and meetings pick back up November 3.
committees.nextSteps: Upload past JAVTE materials to the library. Work with the Conference Committee to share 2027 conference materials on the Resource Exchange after the conference. Consider adding the engagement calendar to AVTE newsletter updates.

committees.name: Veterinary Technician Education Specialist (VTES)
committees.currentFocus: Writing an exam process SOP and growing the question bank.
committees.notes: The online application process is complete, and two new VTESs were welcomed this year. The committee continues refining the website so the information is accurate and easy to use, and is drafting an SOP for the application and testing process.
committees.nextSteps: Finish the exam SOP to set two testing windows about six months apart, and grow the question bank so multiple versions of the exam are available.

committees.name: Awards Committee
committees.notes: No update this cycle. The Awards Committee's work is complete at this time.
committees.nextSteps: None this cycle; the committee reconvenes for the next conference cycle.

committees.name: Advocacy Committee
committees.notes: Tom Beall has stepped in as chair. The committee's review of the three AAVSB revision documents (VCPR model regulations, Article I, and Standards of Practice and Facility) is complete. No report was requested this cycle while the new chair gets started.
committees.nextSteps: Review committee roster and participation under the new chair.

committees.name: Leadership Development Committee
committees.notes: Mission Veterinary Partners is confirmed as a sponsor of ELEVATE. NAVTA and AVTE have completed an MOU covering NAVTA's support, and AVMA and AVTE are finalizing the details of AVMA's in-kind support. Registration has begun, with two forms received to date.
committees.nextSteps: Recruit program mentors. Program kickoff is still targeted for AVMA's 2027 VLC.

committees.name: Industry Support
committees.notes: A promotional package of year-round partnership opportunities is finalized. A tracking sheet of prospective and confirmed partners is built and will be shared with the committee. Conversations are open with several sponsors, with follow-ups pending.
committees.nextSteps: Use board contacts to widen partner connections. Mine Resource Exchange conversations for products members care about, then reach out to those manufacturers and suppliers.

committees.name: Fellows in Veterinary Technician Education (FVTE)
committees.currentFocus: Defining the value of the Fellows designation.
committees.notes: Erin Snyder, Brie Pruitt, and Sarah Charles have joined the committee. The committee has not met since July, but Tara, Michele, and Erin have been working through the chair transition and laying the groundwork for the next meeting.
committees.nextSteps: Book the next quarterly speaker. Define the value of Fellow and Senior Fellow status and how to deliver it to members, clarify the application requirements, and set a target number of Fellows and Senior Fellows.

committees.name: Membership Committee
committees.notes: Nicole has started recruiting committee members, and Jennelle Miller has committed to serve. Her first outreach targeted people who did not attend AVTE this year, programs that lean on preceptorships, and organizations that rely on veterinary technician trainers, all groups with room to grow AVTE membership.
committees.nextSteps: Keep recruiting and hold the first committee meeting in mid-November.

committees.name: Vet Tech New Faculty Academy
committees.chair: Rebecca Newman (Appalachian State University) & Laura Neely (KCTCS), Co-Directors
committees.currentFocus: Running the fall cohort and matching mentors.
committees.notes: The Academy launched October 13 with Tammy Schneider leading a session on pedagogy, and participants were engaged throughout. Module 2, on the new student experience, followed October 20 with Todd Von Deak, Rebecca Newman, and Laura Neely co-presenting. Early Canvas access issues are mostly resolved, and the Canvas course shell on loan from Bel-Rea has made the program feel like a true course.
committees.nextSteps: Close out remaining access issues, finalize each module a week ahead, and review surveys to assign mentors.

committees.name: AVTE Standards Series (CVTEA Webinar Program)
committees.currentFocus: Restarting conversations in late August to push the program forward
committees.notes: 11-month virtual webinar series, September to July, one session per CVTEA Accreditation Standard. Board approved. Karla Lombana has agreed to co-chair. The concept is in place but needs a push. Conversations are restarting in late August to move it forward. Feeds into Resource Exchange discussion threads.
committees.nextSteps: Restart the working conversations in late August. Recruit a co-chair partner to join Karla Lombana. Recruit presenters for Standards 1 to 4. Set up Resource Exchange threads.

committees.name: Career Center
committees.notes: The AVTE Career Center is live at careercenter.avte.net. Recent work has focused on troubleshooting technical issues.

committees.name: Merchandise
committees.notes: Transitioning AVTE branded merchandise to a new online store platform.
committees.nextSteps: Complete platform transition and relaunch store.

committees.name: VT Inclusion, Diversity, Equity & Success (VTIDES)
committees.notes: Active grant management. Ongoing initiative, not a formal committee.

committees.name: VTNE Coalition Workgroup
committees.currentFocus: Coalition gap analysis agreed, next steps in motion ahead of September
committees.notes: Active multi-party partnership with AAVSB, AVMA, NAVTA, CVTEA, and the Canadian VMA. VTNE/CVTEA crosswalk completed. The July meeting at the AVMA Convention in Anaheim was a success, with agreement on the gap analysis and next steps identified for every group. AAVSB bylaw change proposal went public mid-May 2026. Comms plan active.
committees.nextSteps: Groups work their assigned next steps from the gap analysis. Reconvene in September at the AAVSB conference, date set and invites sent. Execute Phase 1 comms plan. Coordinate Portland conference fireside chat.
